title: CO2 Emission Prices, Freight Costs, and Inflation: Some Early Evidence
content: We examine how the recent International Maritime Organization (IMO) regulations, effective as of 2023, have impacted shipping freight rates and inflation in the euro area. Our results, using a Bayesian Vector Autoregression (BVAR) model, suggest that while emission prices tend to have an inflationary effect, this does not seem to apply to shipping. The findings highlight that, over the past two years, freight rates have been largely stable. With prices at equilibrium and demand softening in certain regions due to geopolitical factors, shipowners' capacity to pass on the increased cost of CO2 emission allowances appears constrained.
